abort: retain all failures and stop on any oracle violation, mismatch, unresolved journal, orphan worker, nonfinite loss, missing parameter change, resource ceiling or deadline
acceptance: all worker acknowledgments match the actual active checkpoint hash, model tensor hash and step
every round executes actual changed-parameter AdamW and independent evaluation
each uninterrupted pair has exact equal numerical update records and active state
at least two accepted updates per normal trial
each stale canary is screened before training
all 18 SIGKILL cases retain zero live old descendants and resume an actual optimizer round
recovered round states, candidate updates, decisions and final model/Adam/RNG/step equal matched uninterrupted reference exactly
committed round indices are unique, contiguous and never doubled; aborted computation attempts remain recorded
all final journals clean and active checkpoint intact
backend: PyTorch CPU fp32, one intraop/inter-op thread per process, frozen tied token embeddings, other 2200 parameters trainable
cheaper_alternative: v1 isolated updates and existing runtime/journal regressions cannot establish subsequent worker weight synchronization or post-recovery optimizer continuity.
claim_limits: toy LM, one constrained output token, shared-UID cooperative owner, CPU process faults only; no learning quality, production throughput, hostile isolation, GPU or distributed claim
failure: external supervisor SIGKILLs the actual learner, then terminates all ordinary descendants in its owned POSIX process group before restart. No process may remain executing.
hypothesis: Updated workers serve the actual active checkpoint, and a SIGKILLed learner can resume the next AdamW update with state exactly equal to uninterrupted execution.
max_compute: free M1 Pro/32GiB CPU only; 60 minute campaign deadline, 120 second process progress deadline, 12GiB sampled process-tree RSS ceiling
objective: mean -(reward - 0.5) * conditional log_probability, one AdamW step, lr=0.001, weight_decay=0
primary: normal round throughput includes worker checkpoint synchronization, rollout, verification, replay, AdamW, evaluation, promotion/reject and fsynced round cursor; startup reported separately. Recovery time starts at SIGKILL and ends at the first subsequent completed real optimizer round with a durable cursor.
promotion: nondecreasing independent mean probability of the correct constrained token, min_gain=0, n=32; diagnostic systems acceptance only, no statistical capability decision
recovery: verify actual checkpoint/model/Adam/RNG/step and journal; abort an uncommitted intent or roll forward an already published/committed round; resume next real update. Uncommitted work may be recomputed; committed updates may not be applied twice.
replay: round-local VARE replay with a real base-policy canary after first promotion; both normal arms retain zero-lag checks, guarded additionally authenticates rewards and checkpoint-bound evaluations and journals publication. General replay-backlog recovery is outside scope.
scope: single-host CPU systems validation on fresh synthetic tasks; no model-capability or research-gate claim
task: new v2 nonce namespaces for every seed and round, disjoint training/evaluation prompts; no v1 or retired dataset read
